-- Panel keys: the keyboard moves from control to control, as in a Renoise
-- dialog (and Schism Tracker):
--   Up Down, Tab / Shift-Tab        from control to control
--   Left Right on a slider          change it, by 1; Ctrl x2, Shift x4,
--                                   Alt x8
--   Home / End on a slider          its lowest / highest value
--   a digit on a slider             type the value
--   Left Right on a switch          the other choice
--   Left Right in a row of buttons  the next button
--   Enter                           press a button, flip a switch (on a
--                                   slider: nothing)
--   Esc                             close the panel
-- Everything else goes to Renoise.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- A slider or switch sits in a frame that lights up, in the theme's focus
-- colour, while the keys are on it - the colour a focused button gets, as
-- in Simple Browser (sliders and switches cannot be coloured themselves).
-- The frame is always part of the layout (C.FRAME px round the control) and
-- simply drawn empty otherwise, so moving the focus never moves anything.
C.FRAME = 2
function C.framed(vb, kind, props)
  local F = C.FRAME
  local fid = "frame_" .. props.id
  local ok, frame = pcall(function()
    return vb:canvas {
      id = fid, width = props.width + 2 * F,
      height = (props.height or C.ROW_HEIGHT) + 2 * F, mode = "transparent",
      render = function(ctx)
        if S.lit_frame ~= fid then return end
        local cw, ch = math.floor(ctx.size.width), math.floor(ctx.size.height)
        paint(ctx, "fill_color", C.FOCUS)
        ctx:fill_rect(0, 0, cw, F)
        ctx:fill_rect(0, ch - F, cw, F)
        ctx:fill_rect(0, 0, F, ch)
        ctx:fill_rect(cw - F, 0, F, ch)
      end,
    }
  end)
  local control = vb[kind](vb, props)
  if not ok or not frame then return C.pad(vb, control) end
  local ok2, st = pcall(function()
    local st = vb:stack {}
    st:add_child(frame)
    st:add_child(control)
    control.origin = { x = F, y = F }
    return st
  end)
  return ok2 and st or C.pad(vb, control)
end

-- the same room round a view that has no frame, so every row lines up
function C.pad(vb, v)
  return vb:column { margin = C.FRAME, v }
end

-- light the control the keys are on up, or back to normal
function C.paint_stop(st, on)
  if not st then return end
  local g = view("frame_" .. st.id)
  if g then
    local fid = "frame_" .. st.id
    S.lit_frame = on and fid or (S.lit_frame ~= fid and S.lit_frame or nil)
    pcall(function() g:update() end)
  elseif st.act then                          -- a button: its own colour
    local v = view(st.id)
    if v then C.tint(v, on and C.FOCUS or DEFAULT_COLOR) end
  end
end

function C.ctl_status()
  local st = S.ctl
  if not st then return end
  if st.n then
    set_status(st.name .. ": " .. st.show() .. "  -  Left / Right or Enter change it")
  elseif st.get then
    set_status(st.name .. ": " .. st.show()
               .. "  -  Left / Right change it, or type a value")
  else
    set_status(st.name .. "  -  Enter presses it")
  end
end

local function focus_stop(st)
  if not st then return end
  if S.ctl then C.paint_stop(S.ctl, false) end
  S.ctl, S.last_ctl = st, st.id
  S.row_last = S.row_last or {}
  S.row_last[st.row] = st
  C.paint_stop(st, true)
  C.ctl_status()
end

-- change a value by `n` units: switches wrap round, numbers stop at the ends
function C.value_step(st, n)
  if st.n then
    st.set((st.get() - 1 + n) % st.n + 1)
  else
    st.set(clamp(st.get() + n, st.min, st.max))
  end
  C.ctl_status()
end

-- "Enter Value", as in Schism Tracker: a small prompt (a typed digit, or
-- the current value, already in it). Opened from a timer: Renoise is
-- pickier about prompts opened straight from a key handler or a menu.
function C.value_prompt(st, first)
  local function open()
    remove_timer(open)
    local vb = renoise.ViewBuilder()
    local typed = first or ""
    local tf = vb:textfield { width = 140, text = typed,
                              notifier = function(t) typed = t end }
    pcall(function() tf.edit_mode = true end)
    local content = vb:column {
      margin = renoise.ViewBuilder.DEFAULT_DIALOG_MARGIN, spacing = 6,
      vb:text { text = string.format("%s (%d - %d)", st.name, st.min, st.max) },
      tf,
    }
    local label = renoise.app():show_custom_prompt("Enter Value", content,
                                                   { "OK", "Cancel" })
    if label ~= "OK" then                      -- Cancel, or closed
      if dialog_open() then pcall(function() S.dialog:show() end) end
      return
    end
    local v = tonumber((tf.text or typed or ""):match("[%d%.]+") or "")
    if not v then
      set_status("Not a number: " .. tostring(tf.text))
      return
    end
    st.set(clamp(math.floor(v + 0.5), st.min, st.max))
    if dialog_open() then pcall(function() S.dialog:show() end) end
    C.ctl_status()
  end
  renoise.tool():add_timer(open, 1)
end

function P.key(dlg, key)
  local m = key.modifier_flags or {}
  local name = key.name
  local plain = not (m.shift or m.control or m.alt or m.meta)
  local only_shift = m.shift and not (m.control or m.alt or m.meta)
  local st = S.ctl

  if name == "esc" and plain then dlg:close() return nil end
  if not st then return key end
  local function go(dir)                     -- reading order, round
    local pos = 1
    for i, x in ipairs(S.stops) do if x == st then pos = i end end
    focus_stop(S.stops[(pos - 1 + dir) % #S.stops + 1])
  end

  if name == "tab" and (plain or only_shift) then
    go(only_shift and -1 or 1)
  elseif (name == "up" or name == "down") and plain then
    -- straight up / down: the control right above / below this one (on a
    -- tie the one used last there, else the left one); from a control as
    -- wide as the panel: the one used last in that row, else its first
    local rows = 0
    for _, x in ipairs(S.stops) do rows = math.max(rows, x.row) end
    local want = (st.row - 1 + (name == "down" and 1 or -1)) % rows + 1
    local pick, best = nil, nil
    if st.x == 0.5 and S.row_last and S.row_last[want] then
      pick = S.row_last[want]
    else
      for _, x in ipairs(S.stops) do
        if x.row == want then
          local d = st.x == 0.5 and x.col - 1 or math.abs(x.x - st.x)
          if not best or d < best - 1e-9
             or (math.abs(d - best) < 1e-9 and S.row_last
                 and S.row_last[want] == x) then
            pick, best = x, d
          end
        end
      end
    end
    focus_stop(pick)
  elseif name == "left" or name == "right" then
    local dir = name == "right" and 1 or -1
    if st.n then                               -- a switch
      C.value_step(st, dir)
    elseif st.get then                         -- a slider
      local n = 1
      if m.alt or m.meta then n = n * 8 end
      if m.shift then n = n * 4 end
      if m.control then n = n * 2 end
      C.value_step(st, dir * n)
    elseif plain then                          -- a button: the next one
      local row = {}
      for _, x in ipairs(S.stops) do if x.row == st.row then row[#row + 1] = x end end
      local pos = 1
      for i, x in ipairs(row) do if x == st then pos = i end end
      focus_stop(row[(pos - 1 + dir) % #row + 1])
    else
      return key
    end
  elseif (name == "home" or name == "end") and plain and st.get and not st.n then
    st.set(name == "home" and st.min or st.max)
    C.ctl_status()
  elseif (name == "return" or name == "enter") and plain then
    if key.repeated then return nil end
    if st.act then                             -- a button: press it
      st.act()
      if S.ctl then C.paint_stop(S.ctl, true) end
    elseif st.n then                           -- a switch: flip it
      C.value_step(st, 1)
    end                                        -- a slider: nothing
  elseif plain and st.get and not st.n and key.character
         and key.character:match("^%d$") then
    C.value_prompt(st, key.character)
  else
    return key           -- everything else: Renoise (transport, your keys)
  end
  return nil
end


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Panel layout
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Min gap on its slider: logarithmic, C.GAP_MIN .. C.GAP_MAX
function C.gap_to_slider(ms)
  return math.log(ms / C.GAP_MIN) / math.log(C.GAP_MAX / C.GAP_MIN)
end
function C.slider_to_gap(v)
  return math.floor(C.GAP_MIN * (C.GAP_MAX / C.GAP_MIN) ^ v + 0.5)
end

function P.build()
  local vb = renoise.ViewBuilder()
  S.vb = vb
  S.ctl, S.row_last, S.lit_frame = nil, nil, nil

  local W, GAP, H = C.PANEL_W, C.GAP, C.ROW_HEIGHT
  local CTRL_W = W - C.LABEL_W - C.VALUE_W - 2 * GAP   -- a slider
  local WIDE_W = W - C.LABEL_W - GAP                   -- a switch

  local function pct(v) return string.format("%d %%", v) end
  local function dbs(v) return string.format("-%d dB", v) end
  local function ms(v) return string.format("%d ms", v) end
  local num = function(t) return tonumber((t or ""):match("[%d%.]+") or "") end
  local function pref(name)
    return function() return prefs[name].value end,
           function(v) prefs[name].value = v end
  end
  local function on_off(name)
    return function() return prefs[name].value and 2 or 1 end,
           function(v) prefs[name].value = v == 2 end
  end
  local g_sens, s_sens = pref("sensitivity")
  local g_thr, s_thr = pref("threshold")
  local g_gap, s_gap = pref("min_gap_ms")
  local g_snap, s_snap = pref("snap_mode")
  local g_zero, s_zero = on_off("zero_cross")
  local g_sel, s_sel = on_off("snap_edges")
  local function off_on(g) return function() return g() == 2 and "On" or "Off" end end

  -- every button and setting in reading order: where the keys go.
  -- A button: act; a slider: get / set, min / max; a switch: n choices
  S.stops = {
    { id = "find_btn", row = 1, name = "Find Transients", act = M.find },
    { id = "sens", row = 2, name = "Sensitivity", get = g_sens, set = s_sens,
      min = C.SENS_MIN, max = C.SENS_MAX, show = function() return pct(g_sens()) end },
    { id = "thresh", row = 3, name = "Threshold", get = g_thr, set = s_thr,
      min = C.THRESH_MIN, max = C.THRESH_MAX, show = function() return dbs(g_thr()) end },
    { id = "gap", row = 4, name = "Min gap", get = g_gap, set = s_gap,
      min = C.GAP_MIN, max = C.GAP_MAX, show = function() return ms(g_gap()) end },
    { id = "snap", row = 5, name = "Snap to", n = #C.SNAP_ITEMS,
      get = g_snap, set = s_snap, show = function() return C.SNAP_ITEMS[g_snap()] end },
    { id = "zero", row = 6, name = "Zero crossings", n = 2,
      get = g_zero, set = s_zero, show = off_on(g_zero) },
    { id = "snapsel", row = 7, name = "Snap selection", n = 2,
      get = g_sel, set = s_sel, show = off_on(g_sel) },
    { id = "options_btn", row = 8, name = "Options", act = function()
        pcall(function()
          renoise.app():show_menu(S.dialog, C.option_menu_items(), view("options_btn"))
        end)
      end },
    { id = "help_btn", row = 8, name = "Help", act = function() toggle_help_dialog(true) end },
  }
  local by_id = {}
  for _, st in ipairs(S.stops) do by_id[st.id] = st end
  -- where each control sits across the panel (0 .. 1): a row's controls
  -- share its width equally
  local in_row = {}
  for _, st in ipairs(S.stops) do
    in_row[st.row] = (in_row[st.row] or 0) + 1
    st.col = in_row[st.row]
  end
  for _, st in ipairs(S.stops) do st.x = (st.col - 0.5) / in_row[st.row] end

  -- a click works as a key does: the keys go on from that control
  local function btn(id, text, width, extra)
    local props = { id = id, text = text, width = width, height = H,
                    notifier = function()
                      focus_stop(by_id[id])
                      by_id[id].act()
                    end }
    for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do props[k] = v end
    return vb:button(props)
  end
  local F2 = 2 * C.FRAME                       -- a frame's room in a cell
  local function label(text)
    return C.pad(vb, vb:text { text = text, width = C.LABEL_W - F2, height = H })
  end

  -- a setting: name | slider | value box
  local function slider_row(id, name, slider_props, box_props)
    slider_props.id, slider_props.width, slider_props.height = id, CTRL_W - F2, H
    box_props.width, box_props.height = C.VALUE_W - F2, H
    return vb:row { spacing = GAP, label(name),
                    C.framed(vb, "slider", slider_props),
                    C.pad(vb, vb:valuebox(box_props)) }
  end
  -- a choice: name | switch over the slider and value box
  local function switch_row(id, name, items)
    local st = by_id[id]
    return vb:row { spacing = GAP, label(name), C.framed(vb, "switch", {
      id = id, width = WIDE_W - F2, height = H, items = items, value = st.get(),
      notifier = function(v) if v ~= st.get() then st.set(v) end end }) }
  end

  -- the Min gap slider is logarithmic: it and the pref follow each other
  local gap_slider_props = {
    min = 0, max = 1, value = C.gap_to_slider(prefs.min_gap_ms.value),
    notifier = function(v)
      if S.gap_sync then return end
      S.gap_sync = true
      prefs.min_gap_ms.value = clamp(C.slider_to_gap(v), C.GAP_MIN, C.GAP_MAX)
      S.gap_sync = false
    end,
  }

  local detection = vb:column {
    style = "group", margin = C.GAP * 2, spacing = GAP,
    C.pad(vb, btn("find_btn", "Find Transients", W - F2,
                  { font = "bold", height = H + 6 })),
    slider_row("sens", "Sensitivity",
      { min = C.SENS_MIN, max = C.SENS_MAX, bind = prefs.sensitivity },
      { min = C.SENS_MIN, max = C.SENS_MAX, bind = prefs.sensitivity,
        tostring = pct, tonumber = num }),
    slider_row("thresh", "Threshold",
      { min = C.THRESH_MIN, max = C.THRESH_MAX, bind = prefs.threshold },
      { min = C.THRESH_MIN, max = C.THRESH_MAX, bind = prefs.threshold,
        tostring = dbs, tonumber = num }),
    slider_row("gap", "Min gap", gap_slider_props,
      { min = C.GAP_MIN, max = C.GAP_MAX, bind = prefs.min_gap_ms,
        tostring = ms, tonumber = num }),
    switch_row("snap", "Snap to", C.SNAP_ITEMS),
    switch_row("zero", "Zero crossings", { "Off", "On" }),
    switch_row("snapsel", "Snap selection", { "Off", "On" }),
  }

  local OUTER = W + 4 * C.GAP                  -- a group's width, margins in
  local half = math.floor((OUTER - GAP) / 2)
  return vb:column {
    margin = renoise.ViewBuilder.DEFAULT_DIALOG_MARGIN,
    spacing = GAP * 2,
    detection,
    vb:row { spacing = GAP,
      btn("options_btn", "Options", half),
      btn("help_btn", "Help", OUTER - GAP - half) },
    vb:text { id = "info", text = "", width = OUTER, align = "center" },
  }
end

-- the keys start on the control used last (first time: Find Transients)
function P.focus_start()
  local pick = S.stops[1]
  for _, st in ipairs(S.stops) do if st.id == S.last_ctl then pick = st end end
  focus_stop(pick)
end

-- keep the switches and the log slider in step with the prefs (the keys,
-- Options, the value boxes)
prefs.snap_mode:add_notifier(function()
  local v = view("snap")
  if v and v.value ~= prefs.snap_mode.value then v.value = prefs.snap_mode.value end
end)
prefs.snap_edges:add_notifier(function()
  local v = view("snapsel")
  local want = prefs.snap_edges.value and 2 or 1
  if v and v.value ~= want then v.value = want end
end)
prefs.zero_cross:add_notifier(function()
  local v = view("zero")
  local want = prefs.zero_cross.value and 2 or 1
  if v and v.value ~= want then v.value = want end
end)
prefs.min_gap_ms:add_notifier(function()
  local v = view("gap")
  if v and not S.gap_sync then
    S.gap_sync = true
    v.value = clamp(C.gap_to_slider(prefs.min_gap_ms.value), 0, 1)
    S.gap_sync = false
  end
end)

-- Toggle: open when closed; close when open and focused; when open but
-- Renoise has the focus, bring the panel back to front instead.
function P.toggle()
  if dialog_open() then
    local ok, focused = pcall(function() return S.dialog.focused end)
    if ok and focused == false then
      S.dialog:show()
    else
      S.dialog:close()
    end
    return
  end
  local content = P.build()
  S.dialog = C.show_dialog(TOOL_NAME, content, P.key)
  P.refresh(true)
  P.focus_start()
end

-- a setting changed: the panel shows the new transients
for _, name in ipairs { "sensitivity", "threshold", "min_gap_ms",
                        "snap_mode", "zero_cross" } do
  prefs[name]:add_notifier(function() P.refresh(true) end)
end

-- Simple Transients  -  Renoise 3.5 / Lua API 6.2
--
-- Transient detection for the sample editor, the companion of Simple
-- Browser: step from hit to hit - drum hits in a loop, words in a recording
-- - move the selection's start and end transient by transient, and crop
-- single hits or parts of loops.
--
--   Next / Previous Transient   the cursor to the next / previous hit
--   Selection Start / End       an edge to the next / previous transient
--   Selection Both Edges        out / in by a transient on each side
--   Trim                        left of the cursor, right of it, to the
--                               selection
--   Prehear                     the selection, or from the cursor on
--   Panel                       the detection settings, Options, Help
--
-- NOTE ON KEYS
-- A tool cannot set default keys: bind them in Preferences > Keys >
-- Sample Editor > Simple Transients. Those only fire while the sample
-- editor has the keyboard focus. Help suggests a key set that is free in
-- your own key bindings (Renoise keeps Shift-arrows for its selection).
--
-- NOTE ON THE CURSOR
-- The scripting API shows tools the sample editor's selection, not
-- Renoise's dotted play cursor. So this tool's cursor is a selection one
-- frame long, and its selections are the editor's: Renoise's own play
-- selection, copy into new sample / new instrument act on them. A click
-- in the waveform only moves the dotted cursor (and clears the selection):
-- the tool stays where it was. Click, then Renoise's Shift-arrow, and
-- the tool goes on from there.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local TOOL_NAME = "Simple Transients"
-- constants live in this table (keeps the main chunk under Lua 5.1's
-- limit of 200 local variables)
local C = {}
C.VERSION = "1.0.3"

C.HOP_MS        = 5       -- analysis resolution: one level per 5 ms
C.BUDGET_S      = 0.015   -- background analysis time per timer tick
C.TICK_MS       = 10
C.WAIT_S        = 0.35    -- a key press waits this long for an analysis
C.CACHE_SIZE    = 8       -- samples whose transients are remembered
C.ZC_MS         = 3       -- onsets look this far back for a zero crossing
C.PEAK_MS       = 25      -- "Peak": the loudest frame this soon after onset
C.AUTO_MAX_S    = 3       -- auto-prehear plays at most this much of a hit
C.FP_EVERY_S    = 0.5     -- how often the sample is checked for edits
C.PREFETCH_S    = 0.3     -- settle time before a newly selected sample is
                          -- analysed in the background

C.SENS_STEP     = 5       -- %  (key bindings, the panel's Up / Down)
C.THRESH_STEP   = 3       -- dB
C.SENS_MIN, C.SENS_MAX = 0, 100       -- %
C.THRESH_MIN, C.THRESH_MAX = 6, 90    -- dB below the loudest part
C.GAP_MIN, C.GAP_MAX = 10, 2000       -- ms

C.ROW_HEIGHT    = 18
-- the panel: one grid, every row as wide as the next
C.PANEL_W       = 460     -- inside width of the settings group
C.GAP           = 4       -- between controls
C.LABEL_W       = 96      -- the settings' names
C.VALUE_W       = 76      -- the settings' value boxes

-- Every colour comes from the loaded theme (the slot names of a .xrnc file,
-- lower case), as in Simple Browser, so the tool looks like the rest of
-- Renoise whatever theme is loaded.
C.FOCUS   = "selection_back"           -- the control the keys are on
-- used only if a Renoise version does not know the name above
C.FALLBACK = {
  selection_back = { 255, 143, 53 },
}
local DEFAULT_COLOR = { 0, 0, 0 }      -- {0,0,0} = theme default

-- a view's colour from the theme (RGB fallback if the name is unknown)
function C.tint(v, color)
  if type(color) == "string" then
    if pcall(function() v.color = color end) then return end
    color = C.FALLBACK[color] or DEFAULT_COLOR
  end
  pcall(function() v.color = color end)
end

C.SNAP_ITEMS = { "Onset", "Peak" }

local LOOP_OFF = 1


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Preferences
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local prefs = renoise.Document.create("SimpleTransientsPreferences") {
  prefs_version  = 1,
  sensitivity    = 60,     -- %: how small a jump in level counts as a hit
  threshold      = 40,     -- dB below the loudest part: quieter hits ignored
  min_gap_ms     = 50,     -- two transients are at least this far apart
  snap_mode      = 1,      -- index into C.SNAP_ITEMS
  zero_cross     = true,   -- onsets land on a zero crossing (no clicks)
  follow         = true,   -- scroll the sample editor along with the cursor
  wrap           = true,   -- past the last hit: back to the start
  snap_edges     = true,   -- selection edges move by transient (else fine)
  autoplay       = true,   -- prehear the hit when the cursor moves
  prehear_master = true,   -- prehear on the master track (Renoise default)
}
renoise.tool().preferences = prefs


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The cursor model, in "edges": an edge is the frame a part starts at, so
-- a selection of frames a..b has the edges a and b + 1, and the end of a
-- sample of n frames is edge n + 1. anchor == edge is a plain cursor.
local S = {
  ident   = nil,    -- "instrument:sample" the model belongs to
  anchor  = nil,
  edge    = nil,    -- the edge Next / Previous move
  shown   = nil,    -- { a, b }: the selection this tool put in the editor
  play    = nil,    -- the prehear voice
  pending = nil,    -- { key=, fn= }: an action waiting for the analysis
  dialog  = nil,    -- the panel
  vb      = nil,
}

local A = {          -- analysis
  caches = {},       -- key -> cache
  order  = {},       -- keys, oldest first
  job    = nil,      -- running background analysis
}
local M = {}         -- the commands (keys, menus, MIDI)
local P = {}         -- the panel


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Small helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
  return math.max(lo, math.min(hi, v))
end

-- Messages go to Renoise's own status bar.
local function set_status(msg)
  renoise.app():show_status(TOOL_NAME .. ": " .. msg)
end

local function remove_timer(fn)
  pcall(function()
    local tool = renoise.tool()
    if tool:has_timer(fn) then tool:remove_timer(fn) end
  end)
end

local function restart_timer(fn, ms)
  remove_timer(fn)
  renoise.tool():add_timer(fn, ms)
end

local function dialog_open()
  return S.dialog ~= nil and S.dialog.visible
end

-- A floating window with a key handler. Renoise wants BOTH key options as
-- booleans; if this build does not take them at all, open it without.
function C.show_dialog(title, content, handler)
  local ok, d = pcall(function()
    return renoise.app():show_custom_dialog(title, content, handler,
      { send_key_repeat = true, send_key_release = false })
  end)
  if ok and d then return d end
  return renoise.app():show_custom_dialog(title, content, handler)
end

-- 1.234 s  /  1:02.500
local function fmt_time(frames, rate)
  local s = math.max(0, frames) / math.max(1, rate)
  if s < 60 then return string.format("%.3f s", s) end
  local m = math.floor(s / 60)
  return string.format("%d:%06.3f", m, s - m * 60)
end

-- an edge (1 .. n + 1) as a time from the start of the sample
local function fmt_edge(edge, rate)
  return fmt_time(edge - 1, rate)
end

local function db(power)
  return 10 * math.log10(power + 1e-12)
end


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Wall clock
-- Renoise replaces os.clock() with a high precision timer. The docs are not
-- clear on whether it counts seconds or milliseconds, so measure it once
-- against os.time() shortly after the tool loads, assuming seconds till then.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local clock_scale = 1.0
local calib = { t1 = nil, c1 = nil, start = os.time(), done = false }

local function now()
  return os.clock() * clock_scale
end

local function calib_idle()
  if not calib.done then
    local t = os.time()
    if calib.t1 == nil then
      if t ~= calib.start then calib.t1, calib.c1 = t, os.clock() end
    elseif t >= calib.t1 + 2 then
      local per_second = (os.clock() - calib.c1) / (t - calib.t1)
      if per_second > 100 then clock_scale = 0.001 end
      calib.done = true
    end
  end
  if calib.done then
    local obs = renoise.tool().app_idle_observable
    if obs:has_notifier(calib_idle) then obs:remove_notifier(calib_idle) end
  end
end
renoise.tool().app_idle_observable:add_notifier(calib_idle)


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The selected sample
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- smp, buf, song - or nil and the reason
local function current()
  local song = renoise.song()
  local smp = song and song.selected_sample
  if not smp then return nil, "No sample selected" end
  local buf = smp.sample_buffer
  if not buf.has_sample_data then return nil, "The selected sample is empty" end
  return smp, buf, song
end

local function ident_of(song)
  return song.selected_instrument_index .. ":" .. song.selected_sample_index
end

-- A cheap fingerprint of the audio: length, format and ~60 probed frames.
-- It changes when the sample is edited (by us, by Renoise, by a tool).
local function fingerprint(buf)
  local n = buf.number_of_frames
  local step = math.max(1, math.floor(n / 61))
  local s = 0
  for f = 1, n, step do s = s + buf:sample_data(1, f) * (f % 7 + 1) end
  return string.format("%d:%d:%d:%.9g", n, buf.number_of_channels,
                       buf.sample_rate, s)
end

local function key_of(song, buf)
  return ident_of(song) .. "|" .. fingerprint(buf)
end

-- the editor's selection; a b; "whole" = nothing selected (Renoise then
-- reports the whole sample)
local function selection_of(buf)
  local r = buf.selection_range
  local a, b = r[1], r[2]
  return a, b, (a <= 1 and b >= buf.number_of_frames)
end

-- set the editor's selection (start before end at every step)
local function set_selection(buf, a, b)
  if pcall(function() buf.selection_range = { a, b } end) then return end
  pcall(function()
    if a > buf.selection_end then
      buf.selection_end = b
      buf.selection_start = a
    else
      buf.selection_start = a
      buf.selection_end = b
    end
  end)
end

-- Scroll a zoomed-in sample editor so `f` is in view (a third from the
-- left, so you see what comes next). Zoom stays as it is.
local function follow(buf, f)
  pcall(function()
    local n = buf.number_of_frames
    local len = buf.display_length
    if len >= n then return end                 -- whole sample in view
    local s = buf.display_start
    local margin = math.floor(len / 12)
    if f >= s + margin and f <= s + len - 1 - margin then return end
    -- Renoise's valid range for display_start is 1 .. n - len
    local ns = clamp(f - math.floor(len / 3), 1, math.max(1, n - len))
    if not pcall(function() buf.display_range = { ns, ns + len - 1 } end) then
      buf.display_start = ns
    end
  end)
end


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Transient detection
--
-- 1. Envelope (the slow part, runs in the background): for every 5 ms hop
--    the mean power and the mean power of the first difference (that is
--    the treble: hi-hats, consonants, clicks).
-- 2. Picking (instant, redone when a setting changes): a hop is a
--    transient candidate where the level jumps - the louder of the next two
--    hops against the three before - by at least the Sensitivity's dB, in
--    the full signal or in the treble. Hops quieter than Threshold below
--    the loudest part are ignored. Candidates must be a local maximum;
--    Min gap keeps the strongest of hits that are too close together.
-- 3. Placing (lazily, only around the cursor): the onset is found frame
--    by frame - the point that best splits the hit from what came before -
--    then moved back to the nearest zero crossing.
--    "Peak" puts the cursor on the loudest frame of the hit instead.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Sensitivity (0 - 100 %) -> the jump in level a hit needs, in dB
function C.rise_for(sens)
  return 1.5 + (1 - clamp(sens, 0, 100) / 100) * 22.5
end

function A.remember(c)
  if not A.caches[c.key] then A.order[#A.order + 1] = c.key end
  A.caches[c.key] = c
  while #A.order > C.CACHE_SIZE do
    A.caches[table.remove(A.order, 1)] = nil
  end
end

function A.progress()
  local j = A.job
  if not j then return 100 end
  return math.floor(100 * j.k / math.max(1, j.hops))
end

function A.start(buf, key)
  local n = buf.number_of_frames
  local H = math.max(32, math.floor(buf.sample_rate * C.HOP_MS / 1000 + 0.5))
  A.job = {
    key = key, buf = buf, n = n, rate = buf.sample_rate,
    chs = math.min(2, buf.number_of_channels),
    H = H, hops = math.ceil(n / H), k = 0,
    p = {}, q = {}, last = { 0, 0 }, shown_at = now(),
  }
  restart_timer(A.tick, C.TICK_MS)
end

-- one slice of the envelope; true when the whole sample is done
function A.step(j, budget)
  local buf, H, n, chs = j.buf, j.H, j.n, j.chs
  local p, q, last = j.p, j.q, j.last
  local t_end = now() + budget
  local k = j.k
  while k < j.hops do
    k = k + 1
    local a = (k - 1) * H + 1
    local b = math.min(n, k * H)
    local sp, sq = 0, 0
    for c = 1, chs do
      local prev = last[c]
      for f = a, b do
        local v = buf:sample_data(c, f)
        local d = v - prev
        sp = sp + v * v
        sq = sq + d * d
        prev = v
      end
      last[c] = prev

  local ok, done = pcall(A.step, j, budget)

    if pend and pend.key == j.key then

    end

function A.pick(c)
  local p, q, H = c.p, c.q, c.H
  local K = #p
  local rise_min = C.rise_for(prefs.sensitivity.value)

    local s, cnt = 0, 0

    local r = 0
    local post = db(math.max(p[k], p[k + 1] or 0))
    if post >= floor_db then
      local postq = db(math.max(q[k], q[k + 1] or 0))
      r = math.max(post - pre(p, k), postq - pre(q, k))
    end
    rise[k] = r
  end
  -- local maxima that jump far enough
  local cands = {}
  for k = 2, K do
    local r = rise[k]
    if r >= rise_min then
      local top = true
      for j = math.max(2, k - 2), math.min(K, k + 2) do
        if j ~= k and (rise[j] > r or (rise[j] == r and j < k)) then
          top = false
          break
        end
      end
      if top then cands[#cands + 1] = { k = k, r = r } end
    end
  end
  -- Min gap: the strongest hits first, then whatever still fits in between
  table.sort(cands, function(x, y)
    if x.r ~= y.r then return x.r > y.r end
    return x.k < y.k
  end)
  local gap = math.max(1, math.floor(prefs.min_gap_ms.value / 1000
                                     * c.rate / H + 0.5))
  local taken, ks = {}, {}
  for _, cd in ipairs(cands) do
    local free = true
    for j = cd.k - gap + 1, cd.k + gap - 1 do
      if taken[j] then free = false break end
    end
    if free then taken[cd.k] = true ks[#ks + 1] = cd.k end
  end
  table.sort(ks)
  local points = {}
  for i, k in ipairs(ks) do points[i] = (k - 1) * H + 1 end
  c.points = points
  c.refined, c.ref_next = {}, 1
end

-- Bring a cache up to the current settings (cheap when nothing changed).
function A.fresh(c)
  local ps = prefs.sensitivity.value .. "/" .. prefs.threshold.value
             .. "/" .. prefs.min_gap_ms.value
  if c.p and c.pick_sig ~= ps then
    A.pick(c)
    c.pick_sig = ps
  end
  local rs = prefs.snap_mode.value .. "/" .. tostring(prefs.zero_cross.value)
  if c.ref_sig ~= rs then
    c.refined, c.ref_next = {}, 1
    c.ref_sig = rs
  end
  return c
end

-- the cache of the selected sample (nil while it is not analysed yet)
function A.current(song, buf)
  local c = A.caches[key_of(song, buf)]
  if c then return A.fresh(c) end
  return nil
end

-- Toggle: open when closed; close when open and focused; when open but
-- Renoise has the focus, bring the panel back to front instead.
function P.toggle()
  if dialog_open() then
    local ok, focused = pcall(function() return S.dialog.focused end)
    if ok and focused == false then
      S.dialog:show()
    else
      S.dialog:close()
    end
    return
  end
  local content = P.build()
  S.dialog = C.show_dialog(TOOL_NAME, content, P.key)
  P.refresh(true)
  P.focus_start()
end

  end
  for _, st in ipairs(S.stops) do st.x = (st.col - 0.5) / in_row[st.row] end

  -- a click works as a key does: the keys go on from that control
  local function btn(id, text, width, extra)
    local props = { id = id, text = text, width = width, height = H,
                    notifier = function()
                      focus_stop(by_id[id])
                      by_id[id].act()
                    end }
    for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do props[k] = v end
    return vb:button(props)
  end
  local F2 = 2 * C.FRAME                       -- a frame's room in a cell
  local function label(text)
    return C.pad(vb, vb:text { text = text, width = C.LABEL_W - F2, height = H })
  end

  -- a setting: name | slider | value box
  local function slider_row(id, name, slider_props, box_props)
    slider_props.id, slider_props.width, slider_props.height = id, CTRL_W - F2, H
    box_props.width, box_props.height = C.VALUE_W - F2, H
    return vb:row { spacing = GAP, label(name),
                    C.framed(vb, "slider", slider_props),
                    C.pad(vb, vb:valuebox(box_props)) }
  end
  -- a choice: name | switch over the slider and value box
  local function switch_row(id, name, items)
    local st = by_id[id]
    return vb:row { spacing = GAP, label(name), C.framed(vb, "switch", {
      id = id, width = WIDE_W - F2, height = H, items = items, value = st.get(),
      notifier = function(v) if v ~= st.get() then st.set(v) end end }) }
  end

  -- the Min gap slider is logarithmic: it and the pref follow each other
  local gap_slider_props = {
    min = 0, max = 1, value = C.gap_to_slider(prefs.min_gap_ms.value),
    notifier = function(v)
      if S.gap_sync then return end
      S.gap_sync = true
      prefs.min_gap_ms.value = clamp(C.slider_to_gap(v), C.GAP_MIN, C.GAP_MAX)
      S.gap_sync = false
    end,
  }

  local detection = vb:column {
    style = "group", margin = C.GAP * 2, spacing = GAP,
    C.pad(vb, btn("find_btn", "Find Transients", W - F2,
                  { font = "bold", height = H + 6 })),
    slider_row("sens", "Sensitivity",
      { min = C.SENS_MIN, max = C.SENS_MAX, bind = prefs.sensitivity },
      { min = C.SENS_MIN, max = C.SENS_MAX, bind = prefs.sensitivity,
        tostring = pct, tonumber = num }),
    slider_row("thresh", "Threshold",
      { min = C.THRESH_MIN, max = C.THRESH_MAX, bind = prefs.threshold },
      { min = C.THRESH_MIN, max = C.THRESH_MAX, bind = prefs.threshold,
        tostring = dbs, tonumber = num }),
    slider_row("gap", "Min gap", gap_slider_props,
      { min = C.GAP_MIN, max = C.GAP_MAX, bind = prefs.min_gap_ms,
        tostring = ms, tonumber = num }),
    switch_row("snap", "Snap to", C.SNAP_ITEMS),
    switch_row("zero", "Zero crossings", { "Off", "On" }),
    switch_row("snapsel", "Snap selection", { "Off", "On" }),
  }

  local OUTER = W + 4 * C.GAP                  -- a group's width, margins in
  local half = math.floor((OUTER - GAP) / 2)
  return vb:column {
    margin = renoise.ViewBuilder.DEFAULT_DIALOG_MARGIN,
    spacing = GAP * 2,
    detection,
    vb:row { spacing = GAP,
      btn("options_btn", "Options", half),
      btn("help_btn", "Help", OUTER - GAP - half) },
    vb:text { id = "info", text = "", width = OUTER, align = "center" },
  }
end

-- the keys start on the control used last (first time: Find Transients)
function P.focus_start()
  local pick = S.stops[1]
  for _, st in ipairs(S.stops) do if st.id == S.last_ctl then pick = st end end
  focus_stop(pick)
end

prefs.snap_mode:add_notifier(function()

-- Toggle: open when closed; close when open and focused; when open but
-- Renoise has the focus, bring the panel back to front instead.
function P.toggle()
  if dialog_open() then
    local ok, focused = pcall(function() return S.dialog.focused end)
    if ok and focused == false then
      S.dialog:show()
    else
      S.dialog:close()
    end
    return
  end
  local content = P.build()
  S.dialog = C.show_dialog(TOOL_NAME, content, P.key)
  P.refresh(true)
  P.focus_start()
end

704 PakettiTransientNavigation.lua
-- PakettiTransientNavigation.lua
-- Tab-to-transient navigation for the Renoise Sample Editor.
-- REPORT-CARD >> features/transient-navigation-detection.feature
--
-- The idea (from Pro Tools / REAPER / Acon Acoustica, requested by le(m)on on
-- Discord): step through a sample by detected attack transients the way Renoise
-- lets you step through slices - WITHOUT populating the sample with slice
-- markers. "Next Transient" jumps to the next transient region, selects it, and
-- zooms the waveform so that region is shown in full (like "next slice").
--
-- Detection reuses the BeatDetector engine already in PakettiBeatDetect.lua
-- (filtered envelope-follower + Schmitt trigger, combined lowpass+highpass). The
-- per-frame scan is expensive, so it runs inside a ProcessSlicer (non-blocking,
-- with a progress % in the status bar) and the result is cached per sample. The
-- first navigation kicks off detection and auto-jumps when ready; after that,
-- navigation reads the cache instantly.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Detection defaults (tuned lower than the slice tool so an amen break yields
-- its full set of hits, not just the loudest few).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local TN_DEFAULTS = {
  lowpass_freq = 150, highpass_freq = 3000,
  adaptive_fast_ms = 10, adaptive_slow_ms = 120,
  adaptive_on = 0.012, adaptive_off = 0.004,
  adaptive_min_amp = 0.02, adaptive_ratio = 1.25,
  legacy_rtime = 0.02, legacy_peak_on = 0.04, legacy_peak_off = 0.03,
  min_slice_distance_ms = 10, zero_crossing = 1,
}

-- Fraction of the region length padded on each side when zooming "to fit".
local TN_ZOOM_PAD = 0.04

-- Onset-zoom window: how much of the attack to show, and a little pre-roll so
-- the transient sits just inside the left edge, when zooming in on a transient.
local TN_ONSET_WINDOW_MS = 120
local TN_ONSET_PREROLL_MS = 4

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Cache + detection state
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local tn_cached_positions = nil   -- sorted array of transient frame indices (1-based)
local tn_cached_key = nil         -- fingerprint of the sample the cache belongs to
local tn_detecting = false        -- a ProcessSlicer detection is currently running

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Local helpers (declared BEFORE any function that calls them - Paketti rule 28)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Zero-crossing snap. PakettiBeatDetect's own copy is file-local, so we keep a
-- small equivalent here rather than reaching across files.
local function tn_find_zero_crossing(buffer, pos, search_range_samples, zero_threshold)
  local start_pos = math.max(1, pos - search_range_samples)
  local end_pos = math.min(buffer.number_of_frames, pos + search_range_samples)
  local zero_crossing_pos = pos
  local min_amplitude = math.abs(buffer:sample_data(1, pos))
  for i = pos, start_pos, -1 do
    local v = math.abs(buffer:sample_data(1, i))
    if v <= zero_threshold then zero_crossing_pos = i break
    elseif v < min_amplitude then min_amplitude = v zero_crossing_pos = i end
  end
  if zero_crossing_pos == pos then
    for i = pos, end_pos do
      local v = math.abs(buffer:sample_data(1, i))
      if v <= zero_threshold then zero_crossing_pos = i break
      elseif v < min_amplitude then min_amplitude = v zero_crossing_pos = i end
    end
  end
  return zero_crossing_pos
end

-- Return the selected sample, or nil (with a status message) if there is nothing
-- usable to navigate.
local function tn_current_sample()
  local song = renoise.song()
  local sample = song.selected_sample
  if not sample then
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: no sample selected.")
    return nil
  end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  if not buffer or not buffer.has_sample_data then
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: the selected sample has no audio data.")
    return nil
  end
  return sample
end

-- Fingerprint identifying which sample the cache belongs to. Includes the frame
-- count so any content resize (including our own crops) invalidates it.
local function tn_sample_key(sample)
  local song = renoise.song()
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  return string.format("%d:%d:%d:%d:%d:%s",
    song.selected_instrument_index, song.selected_sample_index,
    buffer.number_of_frames, buffer.sample_rate, buffer.number_of_channels,
    sample.name)
end

-- True when the cache is valid for the given sample.
local function tn_cache_valid(sample)
  return tn_cached_positions ~= nil and tn_cached_key == tn_sample_key(sample)
end

local function tn_positions_to_string(positions)
  local out = {}
  for i, pos in ipairs(positions or {}) do
    out[i] = tostring(pos)
  end
  return table.concat(out, ", ")
end

local function tn_debug_positions(label, positions)
  print(string.format("Transient Nav Debug: %s (%d): %s",
    label, #(positions or {}), tn_positions_to_string(positions)))
end

local function tn_debug_suppressed(label, suppressed)
  local out = {}
  for i, item in ipairs(suppressed or {}) do
    out[i] = string.format("%d(+%d)", item.pos, item.distance)
  end
  print(string.format("Transient Nav Debug: %s (%d): %s",
    label, #(suppressed or {}), table.concat(out, ", ")))
end

local function tn_create_adaptive_schmitt(filter_freq, filter_type, sample_rate)
  local t_filter = 1.0 / (2.0 * math.pi * filter_freq)
  local k_filter = 1.0 / (sample_rate * t_filter)
  local fast_release = math.exp(-1.0 / (sample_rate * (TN_DEFAULTS.adaptive_fast_ms / 1000)))
  local slow_coeff = 1.0 - math.exp(-1.0 / (sample_rate * (TN_DEFAULTS.adaptive_slow_ms / 1000)))

  return {
    filter1 = 0.0,
    filter2 = 0.0,
    fast_env = 0.0,
    slow_env = 0.0,
    trigger = false,
    prev_trigger = false,

    process = function(self, input)
      self.filter1 = self.filter1 + (k_filter * (input - self.filter1))
      self.filter2 = self.filter2 + (k_filter * (self.filter1 - self.filter2))

      local filtered = filter_type == "lowpass" and self.filter2 or (input - self.filter2)
      local env_in = math.abs(filtered)

      if env_in > self.fast_env then
        self.fast_env = env_in
      else
        self.fast_env = self.fast_env * fast_release + (1.0 - fast_release) * env_in
      end
      self.slow_env = self.slow_env + (slow_coeff * (env_in - self.slow_env))

      local novelty = math.max(0.0, self.fast_env - self.slow_env)
      local ratio = self.fast_env / (self.slow_env + 0.000000001)
      local should_trigger = self.fast_env > TN_DEFAULTS.adaptive_min_amp
        and novelty > TN_DEFAULTS.adaptive_on
        and ratio > TN_DEFAULTS.adaptive_ratio
      local should_release = novelty < TN_DEFAULTS.adaptive_off or ratio < 1.05

      if not self.trigger then
        if should_trigger then self.trigger = true end
      elseif should_release then
        self.trigger = false
      end

      local pulse = self.trigger and not self.prev_trigger
      self.prev_trigger = self.trigger
      return pulse, novelty, self.fast_env, self.slow_env
    end
  }
end

-- Called after any destructive edit so the next navigation re-detects.
function PakettiTransientNavInvalidate()
  tn_cached_positions = nil
  tn_cached_key = nil
end

-- Run the combined detector over the sample inside a ProcessSlicer (non-blocking),
-- fill the cache, then call on_done (used to auto-perform the requested jump).
local function tn_start_detection(sample, on_done)
  if tn_detecting then
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: detection already in progress...")
    return
  end
  tn_detecting = true
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local nframes = buffer.number_of_frames
  local sample_rate = buffer.sample_rate
  local key = tn_sample_key(sample)

  local min_slice_distance_samples = math.floor((TN_DEFAULTS.min_slice_distance_ms / 1000) * sample_rate)
  local zero_crossing_threshold = TN_DEFAULTS.zero_crossing / 100
  local search_range_samples = math.floor((10 / 1000) * sample_rate)

  local slicer = ProcessSlicer(function()
    local legacy_low = BeatDetector(TN_DEFAULTS.lowpass_freq, TN_DEFAULTS.legacy_rtime,
      TN_DEFAULTS.legacy_peak_on, TN_DEFAULTS.legacy_peak_off, 'lowpass')
    legacy_low:setSampleRate(sample_rate)
    local legacy_high = BeatDetector(TN_DEFAULTS.highpass_freq, TN_DEFAULTS.legacy_rtime,
      TN_DEFAULTS.legacy_peak_on, TN_DEFAULTS.legacy_peak_off, 'highpass')
    legacy_high:setSampleRate(sample_rate)
    local adaptive_low = tn_create_adaptive_schmitt(TN_DEFAULTS.lowpass_freq, "lowpass", sample_rate)
    local adaptive_high = tn_create_adaptive_schmitt(TN_DEFAULTS.highpass_freq, "highpass", sample_rate)

    local legacy_raw = {}
    local adaptive_raw = {}
    for i = 1, nframes do
      local input = buffer:sample_data(1, i)
      local legacy_low_hit = legacy_low:Process(input)
      local legacy_high_hit = legacy_high:Process(input)
      if legacy_low_hit == true or legacy_high_hit == true then
        legacy_raw[#legacy_raw + 1] = i
      end

      local adaptive_low_hit = adaptive_low:process(input)
      local adaptive_high_hit = adaptive_high:process(input)
      if adaptive_low_hit == true or adaptive_high_hit == true then
        adaptive_raw[#adaptive_raw + 1] = i
      end
      if i % 16384 == 0 then
        renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: detecting transients... %d%%",
          math.floor((i / nframes) * 100)))
        coroutine.yield()
      end
    end

    table.sort(adaptive_raw)
    local filtered = {}
    local last = nil
    local suppressed = {}
    for _, pos in ipairs(adaptive_raw) do
      if not last or (pos - last) >= min_slice_distance_samples then
        local zc = tn_find_zero_crossing(buffer, pos, search_range_samples, zero_crossing_threshold)
        filtered[#filtered + 1] = zc
        last = zc
      else
        suppressed[#suppressed + 1] = {pos = pos, distance = pos - last}
      end
    end

    tn_debug_positions("Legacy level-Schmitt raw hits", legacy_raw)
    tn_debug_positions("Adaptive Schmitt raw hits", adaptive_raw)
    tn_debug_suppressed("Suppressed by min spacing", suppressed)
    tn_debug_positions("Final snapped transients", filtered)

    tn_cached_positions = filtered
    tn_cached_key = key
    tn_detecting = false
    renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: %d transients detected.", #filtered))
    if on_done then on_done() end
  end)
  slicer:start()
end

-- Ensure the cache is populated. Returns true if ready now; false if it kicked
-- off a background detection (which will call retry_action when done).
local function tn_ensure_positions(sample, retry_action)
  if tn_cache_valid(sample) then return true end
  tn_start_detection(sample, retry_action)
  renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: detecting transients, will jump when ready...")
  return false
end

-- display_start / display_length can only be SET while the Sample Editor is the
-- active middle frame (otherwise: "no display_start's are available"). The
-- keybindings are Sample-Editor-scoped so this is normally already true, but make
-- it robust when triggered from a menu on another frame.
local function tn_ensure_sample_editor()
  local w = renoise.app().window
  local target = renoise.ApplicationWindow.MIDDLE_FRAME_INSTRUMENT_SAMPLE_EDITOR
  if w.active_middle_frame ~= target then w.active_middle_frame = target end
end

-- Set the zoom window in a 3-step, always-valid order so display_start +
-- display_length - 1 never transiently exceeds the sample length (Renoise throws
-- and wedges the display otherwise).
local function tn_set_display(buffer, disp_start, disp_len)
  local nframes = buffer.number_of_frames
  disp_len = math.max(1, math.min(disp_len, nframes))
  tn_ensure_sample_editor()
  -- Wrapped in pcall so a display quirk can never crash navigation.
  pcall(function()
    -- When fully zoomed out (display_length == number_of_frames) Renoise refuses
    -- to set display_start ("no display_start's are available"). Bring it back to 1
    -- ONLY while zoomed in, then set the (smaller) length, which makes display_start
    -- settable again.
    if buffer.display_length < nframes then buffer.display_start = 1 end
    buffer.display_length = disp_len
    -- The valid max for display_start is number_of_frames - display_length (NOT
    -- +1, confirmed live) - one over gives "invalid display_start index" near the
    -- end of the sample (the crash le(m)on hit on the last transient). Read the
    -- length back in case Renoise adjusted it, and clamp against nframes - length.
    local actual_len = buffer.display_length
    if actual_len < nframes then
      local max_start = math.max(1, nframes - actual_len)
      buffer.display_start = math.max(1, math.min(disp_start, max_start))
    end
  end)
end

-- Scroll the zoomed waveform so `frame` is visible (centred) when off-screen.
local function tn_follow_view(buffer, frame)
  local view_len = buffer.display_length
  local nframes = buffer.number_of_frames
  if view_len >= nframes then return end
  local vs = buffer.display_start
  local ve = vs + view_len - 1
  if frame < vs or frame > ve then
    local new_start = math.floor(frame - view_len / 2)
    new_start = math.max(1, math.min(new_start, nframes - view_len + 1))
    tn_set_display(buffer, new_start, view_len)
  end
end

-- Order-safe selection set (selection_start is never > end mid-assignment).
local function tn_set_selection(buffer, a, b)
  local cur_end = buffer.selection_end
  if a > cur_end then
    buffer.selection_end = b
    buffer.selection_start = a
  else
    buffer.selection_start = a
    buffer.selection_end = b
  end
end

-- Place a point cursor at `frame` and scroll it into view.
local function tn_show_point(buffer, frame)
  local nframes = buffer.number_of_frames
  frame = math.max(1, math.min(frame, nframes))
  tn_set_selection(buffer, frame, frame)
  tn_follow_view(buffer, frame)
end

-- Select [a..b] and ZOOM the display so that region fills the editor (with a
-- little padding) - the "show it in full" / next-slice behaviour.
local function tn_show_region(buffer, a, b)
  local nframes = buffer.number_of_frames
  a = math.max(1, math.min(a, nframes))
  b = math.max(1, math.min(b, nframes))
  if a > b then a, b = b, a end
  tn_set_selection(buffer, a, b)

  local len = b - a + 1
  local pad = math.floor(len * TN_ZOOM_PAD)
  tn_set_display(buffer, a - pad, len + pad * 2)
end

-- Place a point cursor at `frame` and zoom IN CLOSE on the onset - the transient
-- sits just inside the left edge, showing the attack in detail ("with zoom").
-- region_end bounds the window so we never show past the next transient.
local function tn_show_onset(buffer, frame, region_end)
  local nframes = buffer.number_of_frames
  local sr = buffer.sample_rate
  frame = math.max(1, math.min(frame, nframes))
  tn_set_selection(buffer, frame, frame)

  local preroll = math.floor((TN_ONSET_PREROLL_MS / 1000) * sr)
  local win = math.floor((TN_ONSET_WINDOW_MS / 1000) * sr)
  if region_end then win = math.min(win, (region_end - frame) + preroll + 1) end
  tn_set_display(buffer, frame - preroll, win)
end

-- Augmented boundary list: 1, transients..., number_of_frames.
local function tn_boundaries(sample)
  local positions = tn_cached_positions or {}
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local B = {}
  if positions[1] ~= 1 then B[#B + 1] = 1 end
  for _, p in ipairs(positions) do B[#B + 1] = p end
  local nf = buffer.number_of_frames
  if B[#B] ~= nf then B[#B + 1] = nf end
  return B
end

-- Index k of the chunk [B[k]..B[k+1]] that contains `ref`.
local function tn_current_chunk_index(B, ref)
  for k = 1, #B - 1 do
    if ref >= B[k] and ref < B[k + 1] then return k end
  end
  if ref >= B[#B] then return #B - 1 end
  return 1
end

-- When no explicit selection is made, Renoise reports the selection as the WHOLE
-- sample (selection_start = 1, selection_end = number_of_frames). That must be
-- treated as "no cursor yet", not "at both ends", or Next/Previous always report
-- being at the last/first transient. (This is the bug le(m)on hit.)
local function tn_selection_is_whole(buffer)
  return buffer.selection_start <= 1 and buffer.selection_end >= buffer.number_of_frames
end

-- Reference frame for stepping FORWARD: before-everything when no cursor,
-- otherwise the right edge of the current selection/point.
local function tn_ref_next(buffer)
  if tn_selection_is_whole(buffer) then return 0 end
  return math.max(buffer.selection_start, buffer.selection_end)
end

-- Reference frame for stepping BACKWARD: after-everything when no cursor,
-- otherwise the left edge of the current selection/point.
local function tn_ref_prev(buffer)
  if tn_selection_is_whole(buffer) then return buffer.number_of_frames + 1 end
  return math.min(buffer.selection_start, buffer.selection_end)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Region navigation (select + zoom to fit) - the primary "next slice, but
-- transient" behaviour.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PakettiTransientNextRegion()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if not tn_ensure_positions(sample, PakettiTransientNextRegion) then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local B = tn_boundaries(sample)
  if #B < 2 then renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: no transients detected."); return end
  local ref = tn_selection_is_whole(buffer) and 0 or buffer.selection_start
  local k = tn_current_chunk_index(B, ref) + 1
  if k > #B - 1 then k = 1 end   -- wrap past the last region back to the first
  tn_show_region(buffer, B[k], B[k + 1])
  renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: region %d/%d  frames %d..%d (%d)",
    k, #B - 1, B[k], B[k + 1], B[k + 1] - B[k] + 1))
end

function PakettiTransientPreviousRegion()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if not tn_ensure_positions(sample, PakettiTransientPreviousRegion) then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local B = tn_boundaries(sample)
  if #B < 2 then renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: no transients detected."); return end
  local ref = tn_selection_is_whole(buffer) and (buffer.number_of_frames + 1) or buffer.selection_start
  local k = tn_current_chunk_index(B, ref) - 1
  if k < 1 then k = #B - 1 end   -- wrap before the first region round to the last
  tn_show_region(buffer, B[k], B[k + 1])
  renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: region %d/%d  frames %d..%d (%d)",
    k, #B - 1, B[k], B[k + 1], B[k + 1] - B[k] + 1))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Onset navigation (cursor on the transient, zoomed IN close on the attack) -
-- "next transient with zoom".
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PakettiTransientNextOnset()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if not tn_ensure_positions(sample, PakettiTransientNextOnset) then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local positions = tn_cached_positions
  if #positions == 0 then renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: no transients detected."); return end
  local ref = tn_ref_next(buffer)
  local j = nil
  for i = 1, #positions do if positions[i] > ref then j = i break end end
  if not j then j = 1 end   -- wrap past the last transient back to the first
  local region_end = positions[j + 1] or buffer.number_of_frames
  tn_show_onset(buffer, positions[j], region_end)
  renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: onset %d/%d at frame %d (zoomed)", j, #positions, positions[j]))
end

function PakettiTransientPreviousOnset()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if not tn_ensure_positions(sample, PakettiTransientPreviousOnset) then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local positions = tn_cached_positions
  if #positions == 0 then renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: no transients detected."); return end
  local ref = tn_ref_prev(buffer)
  local j = nil
  for i = #positions, 1, -1 do if positions[i] < ref then j = i break end end
  if not j then j = #positions end   -- wrap before the first transient round to the last
  local region_end = positions[j + 1] or buffer.number_of_frames
  tn_show_onset(buffer, positions[j], region_end)
  renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: onset %d/%d at frame %d (zoomed)", j, #positions, positions[j]))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Point-cursor navigation (place a caret on the transient, scroll into view, no
-- zoom change) - secondary, for when you don't want the view to zoom.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PakettiTransientNextPoint()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if not tn_ensure_positions(sample, PakettiTransientNextPoint) then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local positions = tn_cached_positions
  if #positions == 0 then renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: no transients detected."); return end
  local ref = tn_ref_next(buffer)
  local target = nil
  for _, p in ipairs(positions) do if p > ref then target = p break end end
  if not target then target = positions[1] end   -- wrap past the last back to the first
  tn_show_point(buffer, target)
  renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: cursor at frame %d", target))
end

function PakettiTransientPreviousPoint()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if not tn_ensure_positions(sample, PakettiTransientPreviousPoint) then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local positions = tn_cached_positions
  if #positions == 0 then renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: no transients detected."); return end
  local ref = tn_ref_prev(buffer)
  local target = nil
  for i = #positions, 1, -1 do if positions[i] < ref then target = positions[i] break end end
  if not target then target = positions[#positions] end   -- wrap before the first round to the last
  tn_show_point(buffer, target)
  renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: cursor at frame %d", target))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unified Next/Previous. The preference toggles between the two zoom styles
-- le(m)on asked for: false = onset zoom ("with zoom"), true = whole region in
-- full ("in full with zoom").
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PakettiTransientNext()
  if preferences.pakettiTransientNavSelectMode.value then
    PakettiTransientNextRegion()
  else
    PakettiTransientNextOnset()
  end
end

function PakettiTransientPrevious()
  if preferences.pakettiTransientNavSelectMode.value then
    PakettiTransientPreviousRegion()
  else
    PakettiTransientPreviousOnset()
  end
end

function PakettiTransientToggleSelectMode()
  local v = not preferences.pakettiTransientNavSelectMode.value
  preferences.pakettiTransientNavSelectMode.value = v
  preferences:save_as("preferences.xml")
  renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: Next/Previous now " ..
    (v and "select WHOLE REGION in full (zoom to fit)" or "zoom IN on the onset"))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Re-detect (force recompute; report count)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PakettiTransientRedetect()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  PakettiTransientNavInvalidate()
  tn_start_detection(sample, function()
    renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: detected %d transients.",
      #(tn_cached_positions or {})))
  end)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Slice at cursor
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PakettiTransientSliceAtCursor()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if sample.is_slice_alias then
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: this is a slice alias - slice the master sample instead.")
    return
  end
  if #sample.slice_markers >= 255 then
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: cannot add slice, 255-marker limit reached.")
    return
  end
  local frame = sample.sample_buffer.selection_start
  local ok, err = pcall(function() sample:insert_slice_marker(frame) end)
  if ok then
    renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: inserted slice marker at frame %d", frame))
  else
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: could not insert slice marker (" .. tostring(err) .. ")")
  end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Destructive crop: keep only [keep_start..keep_end], rebuild the buffer in place
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function tn_crop(keep_start, keep_end, cursor_after)
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  if sample.is_slice_alias then
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: cannot crop a slice alias.")
    return
  end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  local nframes = buffer.number_of_frames
  keep_start = math.max(1, math.min(keep_start, nframes))
  keep_end = math.max(1, math.min(keep_end, nframes))
  if keep_end <= keep_start then
    renoise.app():show_status("Transient Nav: nothing left to keep - crop aborted.")
    return
  end
  local new_len = keep_end - keep_start + 1
  local nch = buffer.number_of_channels
  local rate = buffer.sample_rate
  local depth = buffer.bit_depth

  -- Remember frame-referenced properties so we can remap them.
  local old_loop_start = sample.loop_start
  local old_loop_end = sample.loop_end
  local surviving_markers = {}
  for _, m in ipairs(sample.slice_markers) do
    if m >= keep_start and m <= keep_end then
      surviving_markers[#surviving_markers + 1] = m - keep_start + 1
    end
  end

  -- Read the kept region into memory FIRST (create_sample_data wipes the buffer).
  local data = {}
  for ch = 1, nch do
    local col = {}
    for i = 1, new_len do
      col[i] = buffer:sample_data(ch, keep_start + i - 1)
    end
    data[ch] = col
  end

  -- Rebuild in place.
  buffer:create_sample_data(rate, depth, nch, new_len)
  buffer:prepare_sample_data_changes()
  for ch = 1, nch do
    local col = data[ch]
    for i = 1, new_len do
      buffer:set_sample_data(ch, i, col[i])
    end
  end
  buffer:finalize_sample_data_changes()

  -- Remap slice markers (existing markers are cleared by the buffer rebuild).
  for i = #sample.slice_markers, 1, -1 do
    sample:delete_slice_marker(sample.slice_markers[i])
  end
  for _, m in ipairs(surviving_markers) do
    if #sample.slice_markers < 255 then
      pcall(function() sample:insert_slice_marker(m) end)
    end
  end

  -- Clamp loop points into the new length.
  local ns = math.max(1, math.min(old_loop_start - keep_start + 1, new_len))
  local ne = math.max(1, math.min(old_loop_end - keep_start + 1, new_len))
  if ne < ns then ne = new_len end
  pcall(function() sample.loop_start = ns end)
  pcall(function() sample.loop_end = ne end)

  PakettiTransientNavInvalidate()

  local caret = (cursor_after == "end") and new_len or 1
  buffer.selection_start = caret
  buffer.selection_end = caret
  renoise.app():show_status(string.format("Transient Nav: cropped to %d frames (kept %d..%d).",
    new_len, keep_start, keep_end))
end

-- Delete everything to the LEFT of the cursor (keep [selection_start..end]).
function PakettiTransientDeleteLeft()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  tn_crop(buffer.selection_start, buffer.number_of_frames, "start")
end

-- Delete everything to the RIGHT of the cursor (keep [1..selection_end]).
function PakettiTransientDeleteRight()
  local sample = tn_current_sample(); if not sample then return end
  local buffer = sample.sample_buffer
  tn_crop(1, buffer.selection_end, "end")
end
